methodology: Open input file; if input file does not exist, exit.
Open output file; output numbers in appropriate formats.
Read accountNumber and beginningBalance from input file.
Read transactionCode and transactionAmount in a loop controlled by EOF.
If transactionCode is 'D' or 'd', add transactionAmount to accountBalance and increment numberOfDeposits.
If transactionCode is 'I' or 'i', add transactionAmount to accountBalance and add transactionAmount to interestPaid.
If transactionCode is 'W' or 'w', subtract transactionAmount from accountBalance and increment numberOfWithdrawals.
If accountBalance < MINIMUM_BALANCE and service charge has not been applied, subtract SERVICE_CHARGE from accountBalance and set isServiceCharged to true.
If transactionCode is other than 'D', 'd', 'I', 'i', 'W', or 'w', output an error message.
